coder_notes: Basket: GBM IDH-wildtype grade 4 eligible in Part 1 (dose escalation) and Part 4a (CNS tumour expansion), both ABBV-706 monotherapy. Combination arms (3a budigalimab; 3b carboplatin/cisplatin) enrol SCLC/NEC only; regimen coded 'combination' at trial level although GBM patients receive monotherapy. ABBV-706 coded experimental_monotherapy (sole investigational agent in Parts 1/2/4); budigalimab experimental_combination (stated investigational). Carboplatin/cisplatin coded soc_backbone as standard platinum partners in Part 3b only - adjudicator may consider them experimental partners. SEZ6 is not explicitly stated as ABBV-706's target; matching inferred from 'potential SEZ6 expression' selection and SEZ6-ADC exclusion - retrospective/correlative so not affecting the primary outcome. IDH, 1p/19q and EGFR mentions define eligible tumour types (diagnostic), not candidate-matched. Brain metastases also eligible.
